observations: Green alternator head mounted on a wooden base.
Control box features an analog voltmeter, a circuit breaker, and a toggle switch.
A yellow technical specification plate is present on the side but the text is illegible.
The drive shaft has a yellow protective cap.

claims.evidence: Requires physical inspection of the internal windings to confirm material.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the yellow technical specification plate.

risks.risk: Internal windings may be aluminum or damaged
risks.proof: Video of the machine under load showing stable voltage output.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the yellow technical specification plate to determine kVA, voltage, and RPM.
Video of the alternator coupled to a motor and producing stable voltage on the meter.
response.reason: The capacity (kVA) of the alternator is the primary driver of its value and is currently unreadable on the technical plate. Without this information, it is impossible to provide a price.
